summary: Newegg Commerce, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. The filing includes financial metrics such as adjusted EBITDA of $10.0 million, net income of $7.8 million, and GMV of $377.5 million, with commentary on market conditions and strategic initiatives. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing constitutes a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, with no event triggering a special-situations classification. Management changes or strategic reviews are not referenced.
